Name: (CP) More Vanilla Interiors
Author: illulen
Description:
[url=https://ko-fi.com/illulen][center]﻿Feel free to donate me at my ko-fi![/center][center]﻿[/center][/url]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/ClmF3cr.png[/img]

This mod features a bunch of vanilla-style furniture and windows for your farmhouse. This mod currently has:
[list=1]
[*]6 end & wide tables (rotatable) (currently only in oak variant) -- haven't gotten around the back part of the end table, if anyone can help, let me know!
[*]6 windows
[*]Currently only have default i18n support
[/list]
I just came back for a bit; these are some of my unreleased furniture I haven't gone to adding more.

I'm planning to release a furniture set that is vanilla-style, watch out for it :)!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kvDU6sV.png[/img]

To install this mod, you need to:
[list=1]
[*]download[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915] Content Patcher[/url]
[*]﻿unzip the mod file into your mods folder and;
[*]run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
If you're having error items, it's most likely that[size=2]:[/size]
[list=1]
[*]my mod updated and had sprite indexes/ID changes;
[*]you can remove the error furniture just fine and trash it
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/2Zr34DA.png[/img]

This mod should be compatible with most mods; however, it may take priority over other mods that retexture TVs using Content Patcher. I have added an option to disable my TV retextures for that case.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/rWKGjE7.png[/img]

I'm having a hard time finding your furniture﻿
[list]
[*]Currently, all my stuff is in the furniture catalogue, I [s]suggest [/s] require you to download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] to easily search for my furniture
[/list]
Can I edit the mod
[list]
[*]Please refer to permissions & credits for that.
[/list]
